claims.statement: Show previous professional roles and companies for each person.
Compare employment periods at the same company to find likely personal connections.
Present a readable LinkedIn-like experience history; exact page layout is not selected.
Explain overlap through both people's roles and employment periods.
Keep suggested connections separate from confirmed relationships; do not create edges solely from membership.
